propositions: Five investigation artifacts cited by merged code (Gerrit 1891, cranial-goodly-seahog and restoring-shallow-blobfish) exist only as untracked working-tree state and are not committed to origin/main, leaving dangling citations in criteria_routing.json and unprovable audit trails for the code-review thresholds and parity-oracle design.

criteria_routing.json _comment fields reference docs/experiments/calibrate_code_review_thresholds.py, but the file does not exist on main, making the provenance and justification for four threshold-blocking flips unverifiable from the repo.

The five artifacts (calibration harness, calibration report, escaped-bug analysis harness, escaped-bug gap report, parity-oracle prototype) are final deliverables already written and recorded on closed tickets; landing them requires verbatim commit with no code changes.
Gerrit change 1904 lands the five artifacts to docs/experiments/ (835 insertions, no existing files modified) as docs-only, outside lint sources and wheel packages, with no runtime behavior change.
